decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX trommel screen is a further development of the established BASIC 518, a core screening competence where the firm can interpret results and improve the machine, so it stays.
The AK flail shredder line was upgraded to EU Stage V engines, showing ongoing in-house development of a product close to the firm's core shredding know-how.

The high-speed grinder line builds on the firm's mobile shredding expertise and was given its own page in 2019, but the similar green-waste grinder E was dropped, which suggests some portfolio consolidation risk.

The CERON stationary pre-shredder generation is positioned as setting benchmarks and is used in plant references, extending the firm's shredding knowledge into stationary plants with evident development effort.
